cell.label: Patient presenting with symptoms of fever, chills, headache, myalgias, nausea and vomiting, splenomegaly, and/or jaundice. History of travel to or moving from a malaria-endemic area?
Malaria likely. Microscopist experienced in malaria diagnosis?
Do peripheral blood stained with Giemsa.
Do rapid assay and confirm if positive. (Send blood smear to experienced laboratory or contact CDC at dpdx@cdc.gov or 770-448-7788.)

footnotes.footnote: Data from Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Malaria Diagnosis and Treatment.
